description: Ex-VASP Boeing 737-300 bought from TAP M&E at Porto Alegre and trucked 390 km to Panambi in Nov 2010; fitted out as a cinema and library. Registration per Feb 2026 AeroEntusiasta compilation.
Second Boeing 737-300 (ex KLD/Kalitta, N393US) trucked from Porto Alegre in 2012 and used as an exhibition hall for FEB artefacts. Registration per Feb 2026 compilation.

Total Linhas Aéreas 727-200F PR-TTP, the last 727 operating in Brazil, written off in the May 2024 Porto Alegre floods (the widely photographed 'flooded 727'); donated to the museum and moved by road 2-3 Nov 2025.
Ex-FAB DHC-5 Buffalo, last flight 19 April 2007, displayed complete at the museum entrance; serial per Feb 2026 compilation.
Second Buffalo, fuselage only, per Feb 2026 compilation.
Ex-FAB EMB-110 Bandeirante C-95, complete, the subject of the museum's Jan 2026 'Aeronave Embraer Bandeirante C-95' post; serial not published (first of two).
Second ex-FAB Bandeirante, fuselage only per Feb 2026 compilation; serial not published (second of two).
Ex-FAB EMB-111 Bandeirante Patrulha P-95A 7052 (museum post 'Aeronave EMB-111 Bandeirante Patrulha P-95'); serial per Feb 2026 compilation.

description: Ex-FAB Xavante (museum post 'Aeronave Embraer Xavante AT-26'). The Feb 2026 compilation gives 4616, but Pass 3 has recorded 4616 for the Paulo Bento monument; one of the two numbers is painted, so the tail is left blank here and 4616 kept as an alias.
Ex-FAB UH-1H hulk bought at auction 28 Nov 2018 and released by the US DoD in Sept 2019 for display; serial per Feb 2026 compilation, which lists three H-1Hs at the museum.
Second ex-FAB UH-1H (serial partly read as 8?60 in the Feb 2026 compilation).
